body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Matsunichi presented its 7-inch digital frame ´iPF7` with iPod docking station during CES 2007. It plays for 4 hours of video file in 16:9 ratio on 7-inch wide screen equipped with two-way built-in speakers. Digital clock, calendar and alarm functions are included.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Nikki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Seo>
